g.text: D20 retained: matched event-excluded seasonal forecasts
Same SST/D20/PMM states, training windows and preprocessing as the process reconstruction
34 training years; exclude 1996–1998, 2014–2016, 2022–2024. February–June starts; common center leads 1–5.
25 overlapping start–season pairs/event, 9 distinct targets. Future non-event training data and published PMM pattern are used.
Event-excluded retrospective test; differs from the original 2002–2024 in-sample display. No later observed forcing.
